description: List current PC game deals under a price, one row per game at its cheapest tracked store. Useful for gift ideas within a budget. Set max_price to 0 for games that are free right now. Set record_low to true to learn, for up to 25 deals, whether today's price matches the lowest price on record. Defaults keep only games with at least 80 percent positive reviews from at least 300 reviewers. Prices in US dollars.

min_price.description: Lowest price in US dollars. Use 1 to leave out free games.

min_review_percent.description: Lowest share of positive Steam reviews. Defaults to 80.

min_reviews.description: Lowest number of Steam reviews. Defaults to 300.

record_low.description: Adds at_record_low and lowest_price_ever to each deal. Limits the list to 25.

sort.description: best (deal quality), discount, price, reviews, metacritic or recent. Defaults to best.

name: top_deals
title: Best game deals under a budget
